fullContentHtml:
MPESB Group 2 Sub Group 4 Patwari & Various Posts Admit Card 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Madhya Pradesh Professional Selection Board (MPESB) has released the admit card for the post of Group 2 Sub Group 4 Patwari & Various Posts. This recruitment was released for 2106 posts. Applications for the MPESB Group 2 Sub Group 4 Patwari & Various Posts Recruitment 2026 were accepted from 04 August 2026, to 21 August 2026. The written examination is going to be started on 22 September 2026. Candidates who had applied this form can check their MPESB Group 2 Sub Group 4 Patwari & Various Posts Admit Card 2026 from the link given below.

How to Download Admit Card

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the admit card / hall ticket link.
  3. Enter your registration number / roll number and date of birth / password.
  4. Click on submit to view your admit card.
  5. Download and take a printout. Carry it to the exam center along with a photo ID.
